editorial:
You follow Cam, a New York City bike messenger who is drowning in debt to the mafia. When a beautiful stranger named Nikki crashes into his life, she pulls him into the fast and dangerous world of parkour. Soon he is running across rooftops, flipping over walls, and learning to move like a shadow. The story is simple but fun, and the city setting gives everything a gritty, street-level energy that keeps you watching. Taylor Lautner does solid work as Cam, and the parkour scenes are the real star of the show.

The action is quick and exciting, with lots of chases and stunts that feel real because the actors actually do many of them. The pacing rarely slows down, which is great if you want a thrill ride, though the romance and side characters do not get much depth. If you enjoy action movies with cool stunts and do not mind a thin plot, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Cam turns against the parkour crew and the mafia boss who has been using them for robberies. He fights his way through the crew and confronts the boss, using his new parkour skills to escape and outsmart them. Nikki helps him, and the two manage to get away. The movie ends with Cam free from his debt and the mafia, walking away with Nikki as the police close in on the criminals behind him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stunt-heavy action and parkour chases.
